sections.title: What YuSleep Is: Bottle & Serving Walkthrough
sections.purpose: Show the physical bottle artwork, explain that YuSleep is a liquid dietary supplement rather than a prescription drug, and note the serving size and corporate entities.
sections.visualFormat: High-Resolution Bottle Walkthrough Slide + Authentic Sarah Voice
sections.spokenScript: So, what is YuSleep on paper? According to the supplied label artwork, it is a liquid dietary supplement in a two fluid ounce, or sixty milliliter, dropper bottle. One serving is two milliliters, which is two full droppers, giving you roughly thirty servings per bottle. Notice one practical detail right away: the Supplement Facts panel does not print a specific minute-by-minute bedtime window, so you should check the physical bottle before use. Also note that while the label lists For Women's Health LLC in Wilmington, Delaware, the checkout is processed by ClickBank.

sections.title: Supplement Facts Close-Up: Exact Milligrams vs. The 637 mg Blend
sections.purpose: Zoom directly into the supplied Supplement Facts panel to distinguish individually disclosed amounts (0.5 mg B2, 0.5 mg B6, 0.9 mg Melatonin) from the 637 mg Proprietary Blend.
sections.visualFormat: High-Resolution Supplement Facts Label Zoom + Nutrient Callouts + Authentic Sarah Voice
sections.spokenScript: Let us zoom in on the Supplement Facts panel, because this is where smart buyers pause and read closely. Three nutrients have exact individual amounts per two-milliliter serving: Vitamin B2 as riboflavin 5-phosphate at 0.5 milligrams, or 38 percent of the Daily Value; Vitamin B6 as pyridoxal 5-phosphate at 0.5 milligrams, or 29 percent of the Daily Value; and melatonin at 0.9 milligrams. Below that is a 637 milligram Proprietary Blend combining Red Tart Cherry Juice Concentrate, Magnesium Glycinate, Apigenin, Lemon Balm Extract, 5-HTP from Griffonia seed, L-Theanine, and GABA. Have you ever noticed how blends work? You get the combined 637 milligram total, not the individual dose of each botanical or amino acid.

sections.title: Evidence Boundaries & Personal Suitability
sections.purpose: Separate general ingredient familiarity from finished-product clinical proof and remind viewers to review melatonin, 5-HTP, and GABA with a clinician or pharmacist.
sections.spokenScript: Now, how should we think about the science? Many adults recognize ingredients like melatonin, magnesium glycinate, L-theanine, or tart cherry from general nutrition articles. However, familiarity with individual ingredients is not the same thing as an independent clinical trial on this finished combined liquid formula. We have not verified clinical study proof for the finished YuSleep product. And because this formula combines melatonin with 5-HTP and GABA, anyone taking prescription medications, especially antidepressants or sedatives, should show this exact label to a physician or pharmacist first.

sections.title: Three Calm Buyer Checkpoints Before You Decide
sections.purpose: Give viewers a self-screening checklist so they can decide at their own pace without urgency or pressure.
sections.spokenScript: Before clicking any order button, ask yourself three calm questions. First, am I comfortable with a 0.9 milligram melatonin liquid formula that uses a 637 milligram proprietary blend? Second, have I checked whether I am selecting one-time billing or bi-monthly auto-ship on the two-bottle package? And third, have I cleared the ingredient list with my doctor or pharmacist?
